reading.title: PILOT Agreement Transmittal Letter for Fort Washington by Vintage

candidates.quote: The Project involves the acquisition and rehabilitation of a three hundred four (304) unit affordable rental community for low and moderate-income households, earning seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income ("AMI"), located at 2428 Corning Avenue, Fort Washington, Maryland 20744.

The Project involves the acquisition and rehabilitation of a three hundred four (304) unit affordable rental community for low and moderate-income households, earning seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income ("AMI"), located at 2428 Corning Avenue, Fort Washington, Maryland 20744.
candidates.wording: seventy percent (70%) or below of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment of no less than approximately one hundred seventeen thousand, six hundred forty-eight dollars or three hundred eighty-seven dollars per unit ($117,648 or $387 per unit) for the first year.
candidates.wording: mandatory annual payment of no less than

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for forty (40) years, including the extended affordability period.
candidates.wording: remain in effect for forty (40) years

candidates.quote: When considering the financial effects of the PILOT, the County will be providing yearly operating support of approximately three hundred sixty-four thousand, eight hundred sixty-three dollars ($364,863) to this affordable family housing development.
